meta.title: Draeven
meta.description: A Discord framework built from scratch — commands, events, and an optional owner desk.

mega.apiBody: Packages, classes, and signatures like discord.js docs.

home.headline: Discord bots with one typed ctx.
home.lead: Declarative slash commands, gateway events, and an optional owner desk. No discord.js client. Guild SaaS is separate — build it yourself, or buy it later.
home.stackBody: Core writes bots. Bridge is an optional ops desk for your process. A multi-tenant guild dashboard is not in this box.
home.featureCommandsBody: Slash, groups, menus, autocomplete — one typed ctx per handler.
home.featureBridgeBody: Embedded, bridge, or desk — status and actions for the bot you run.
home.featureDxBody: Stay connected while commands change; optional error guard.
